{
  "manifest_version": 3,
  "name": "WME - RightClick Functions",
  "version": "1.4.26",
  "version_name": "Beta",
  "description": "Right-click tools, Map Pins, Friends sharing, reminders, backups and WME integrations without Tampermonkey.",
  "permissions": [
    "storage",
    "unlimitedStorage",
    "clipboardWrite"
  ],
  "host_permissions": [
    "https://www.waze.com/*",
    "https://beta.waze.com/*",
    "https://w-tools.org/*",
    "https://update.greasyfork.org/*",
    "https://deployable-assets.editorx.dev/*",
    "https://accounts.google.com/*",
    "https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/*",
